'''September 2000 Green Bay tournament (16 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Green Bay, Wisconsin on 16 September 2000. [[Mark Kloida]] won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1236">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-gb-9-16d1236/ gb-9-16], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-gb-9-16d1236/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Mark Kloida]]
